def equation(gate_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, drain_voltage_abs: np.ndarray, parameters: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Modelo empírico bivariado para log10(|ID|/A)."""
    a1, a2, a3, a4, b1, b2, b3, b4, c, d = parameters
    return (a1 * np.power(gate_voltage_abs, 3) + a2 * np.power(gate_voltage_abs, 2) + a3 * gate_voltage_abs + a4) * (c * np.power(drain_voltage_abs, 3) + d * np.power(drain_voltage_abs, 2)) + b1 * np.power(gate_voltage_abs, 2) + b2 * gate_voltage_abs + b3
